reapack.name: RenderSmith.lua
reapack.desc: RenderSmith - Region naming & batch asset delivery

metadata.description:
RenderSmith turns a REAPER session into delivered game-audio assets.
It finds the individual sounds inside your track folders, names them from the folder hierarchy or the UCS 8.2 standard, and renders each one to its own file in an organised output tree.
Free for 7 days with every feature unlocked, then it needs a license key: a one-time purchase that does not expire. The key is emailed the moment you buy.
Features: - Gap clustering: one region per sound, so twenty gunshots in one folder become twenty files - Cluster preview before you create anything, with a live count on the button - NameSwitch markers: one folder can hold many differently named sounds - Isolated renders: overlapping folders never bleed into each other's files - Direct render engine, writing WAV without opening REAPER's render window - UCS 8.2 naming per audio type, with the full 82-category catalog built in - Custom wildcards, custom audio types and custom per-type fields - Per-track overrides that travel inside the .rpp - Overwrite protection before anything is replaced
Requires Lokasenna_GUI v2, which ReaPack can install for you.

version.author: Panchuel
version.changelog:
RegionForge is now RenderSmith. The name follows what the tool actually does: regions were only ever the intermediate step.
- Gap clustering, so a folder yields one region per sound instead of one region per folder - Cluster preview drawn on a temporary track, plus a live region count on the Create Regions button - NameSwitch markers: rename regions and restart numbering partway through a folder, so one folder can hold several different sounds - Fixed a long-standing audio bug: folders overlapping in time bled into each other's rendered files. Each region now renders in isolation, and folder routing still survives - Region identity moved to GUIDs, with per-region metadata in the project rather than global state, so hierarchies no longer leak between projects - Overwrite protection: RenderSmith asks REAPER which files it would write and warns before replacing any - Regions are reused instead of duplicated when one already matches - Hybrid regions: keep them in the project, or let them exist only for the render - A shared $RF[NAME] wildcard dictionary with global and per-project scope - Per-track overrides for audio type, output folder and gap - Mutation journal: every temporary change is undone, and anything you edited underneath is left alone - Tabs reorganised into Main, Config, Render and License - 7 day trial and license key activation
